system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: You are assisting humans doing web navigation tasks step by step.
system_prompt_style.note: System prompt is a fixed string in _initialize_prompts; the query prompt is composed with task, previous actions and choices. Line number approximate within the shown excerpt.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: The screenshot below shows the webpage you see.
env_context_strategy.note: Screenshot plus ranked or extracted interactive element choices are injected each step. The model can also navigate with scroll/goto actions. Closest fit for web: mixed.

context_compaction.note: The history handling code is truncated in the bundle, so the history processor was not visible.

observation_format.evidence_quote: `text_choice_som`: use text choices with set of marks
observation_format.note: Default grounding strategy is text_choice_som (screenshot with marks plus textual element choices). The text_choice option is also available.

tool_call_format.note: Actions are parsed from free text using Answer/Action/Value fields; this is not JSON. json_in_text is the closest value (ambiguity).
